mechanism.claim: When completed ETH five-minute returns consistently precede BTC five-minute returns in one direction during a high-variation BTC block, ETH is transmitting marginal crypto risk information into BTC. Apply the frozen ETH-to-next-BTC response sign to the completed ETH displacement and follow that predicted BTC direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of ETH-to-next-BTC return correlation multiplied by the completed eight-hour ETH return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVEBLR correlates current ETH signed returns with the following BTC signed return. ETH leadership uses same-block magnitude dominance, ETH disagreement uses endpoint sign conflict, ETH jump catchup selects one jump, and ETH beta catchup fits a prior contemporaneous regression. No prior event set, diagnostic control, fitted outcome, funding, OI, premium, or flow input is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal BTC variation tail selects volatile blocks while an ETH-leading response tail identifies staged cross-asset information transmission
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily ETH-to-BTC lead-response onsets with eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 96 exact aligned BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT perpetual five-minute aggregates, each from 480 unique one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.lead_response: sample Pearson correlation of eth_bar_return[t] and next_btc_bar_return[t+1] across 95 ordered pairs; both sample standard deviations strict positive; correlation strict nonzero
features.response_strength_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(lead_response) over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTC five-minute close/open log returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eth_block_return: log(last ETH close/first ETH open), strict nonzero; predicted BTC direction is sign(lead_response*eth_block_return)
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no lag, correlation, rank, mapping, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
